name: Aang vs Ozai
author: SabrinaBP
description:
An Avatar: The Last Airbender themed spin on Prototype 4, with all bonus features included and a 'Continue' button. Made for Unit 4 of the Create with Code course.
EDIT: You can use the arrow keys as well as WASD. For some reason the arrow symbols in the UI don't appear in the WebGL version, though they did in Unity.
